primary_source_inspected.title: Directly Visible Pairs and Illumination by Reflections in Orthogonal Polygons
primary_source_inspected.extent: All four pages of primary paper, including sections 3.1 and 3.2 and conclusion
primary_source_inspected.scope: Diffuse illumination bounds; specular visibility complexity and simple connectedness for at most two reflections
primary_source_inspected.applicability: No claim that every actual target is reached by a finite specular path. Simple connectedness of a visible subset does not imply it equals the room.

search_limits: Focused queries only. Empty or irrelevant results are not evidence of absence of a theorem. Earlier A03 already found the general diffuse/specular distinction; no independent new theorem counted.
